messages:
Mike Chen: quick flag on /v1/generate docs: `timeout` is shown as a string in the OpenAPI and examples, but the service now expects an integer `timeout_ms`. also examples show `generation` singular but runtime returns `generations` array. can we fix?

Sara Patel: thanks Mike. which spec file? and can you paste a repro?

Mike Chen: openapi/specs/generate.yaml. repro: `curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?timeout=5000' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hi"}'` -> 400 invalid type for timeout. server uses `timeout_ms` int now.

Jonathan Reed: confirmed. we renamed param server-side to `timeout_ms` and removed string coercion. update OpenAPI to `timeout_ms` in query with type integer (format int32) and example 5000. we also accept header `X-Timeout-Ms`.

Lee Park: i'll open a docs PR to update: OpenAPI param, curl/python/js examples, add short migration note under docs/migrations, and a changelog entry. PR will include mapping note for SDK camelCase.

Mike Chen: YAML snippet for the param to use:
```yaml
parameters:
  - name: timeout_ms
    in: query
    schema:
      type: integer
      format: int32
      example: 5000
```
response sample should be updated to use `generations` array, e.g. `{ "id":"req_..", "model":"rwd-13b", "generations":[{"text":"hi","tokens":["hi"]}], "perf":{"latency_ms":37} }`.

Sara Patel: small SDK note: JS uses `timeoutMs` (camelCase). please add a one-liner in the migration doc: HTTP `timeout_ms` -> JS `timeoutMs`.

Jonathan Reed: also add an infra smoke test that checks `generations` exists in responses to catch regressions.

Lee Park: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infer/docs/pull/4529 (labels: docs, breaking-change, needs-review). assigning @Sara Patel @Mike Chen.

docs-bot: PR opened by Lee Park: https://git.redwood/infer/docs/pull/4529 (labels: docs, breaking-change, needs-review).

Mike Chen: i'll run a quick staging smoke after merge and post results.

Sara Patel: will review the SDK snippet changes once PR is ready.

Lee Park: thanks all, aiming to merge after 2 approvals and green CI :thumbsup:
